name: Table I v2 (Replica): read-out-only predictives selected on validation
status: registered before any v2 run (validation or test); scripts/replica_tab1_v2.sh refuses to run while this file has uncommitted changes
maps: the existing v1 3DGS maps and fields (no re-mapping, no distillation): every new row is a read-out of the saved field statistics
pipeline: scripts/replica_tab1_v2.sh: STAGE=val (fit one temperature per row on the validation scenes, evaluate them, write the selection), then STAGE=test once
test_look: SECOND look at the Replica test split: the first was Table I v1 (code 224fe1e); the v2 report and the paper say so

metric.name: nll
metric.text: validation NLL in nats with the coverage rule (variant 'all'), pooled over the labelled pixels of all validation scenes: sum_s n_s NLL_s / sum_s n_s, n_s = labelled pixels of scene s; temperatures fit by eval_seg.py on the same validation scenes (one per row, as in v1)

tie.rule: candidates within tol nats of the lowest value tie; the tie goes to the one listed first; lists run from the reference setting outward (P1: c0 = 1, the FieldConfig default; P4: lambda = 1, the vMF moment match, then alpha0 = 1, the flat Dirichlet of CSS's default; @ours_v2: the v1 predictive ours_P2 first, so a v2 row must beat it by more than tol)

reporting: Every candidate (ours_P2, ours_P2p1, the P1 c0 grid, the P4 grid) and the ablation ours_P4_inf is evaluated on validation and test and reported in the v2 report, selected or not; test numbers of rows not selected are labelled 'not selected'.
@ours_v2 is the open-vocabulary predictive of Table I v2; if it is ours_P2, Table I keeps v1's P2 and the v2 rows are reported as not better on validation.
The v1 rows, betas and test record are kept unchanged; v2 numbers live in their own records (uags_results/tab1_v2).
The selection is final once STAGE=test starts: test numbers never change a choice, a grid, a tie rule or this file.
The paper states that the v2 rows were scored on the Replica test split in a second look, after the v1 table, with every choice fixed on validation beforehand.
